en: Verb classes XI–XIV: brať, vziať, pozrieť, minúť
The past of modal and irregular verbs
t: Tuslanish turlari XI–XIV: brať, vziať, pozrieť, minúť
Modal feʼllar va istisnolarning oʻtgan zamoni

a2-u2-l1.volny-cas.note.en: **Vo voľnom čase** = in your free time. **tráviť** voľný čas = to spend your free time: Ako trávite voľný čas?
a2-u2-l1.volny-cas.note.t: **Vo voľnom čase** = boʻsh vaqtda. **tráviť** voľný čas = boʻsh vaqtni oʻtkazmoq: Ako trávite voľný čas? = Boʻsh vaqtingizni qanday oʻtkazasiz?

a2-u2-l1.co-rada-robis.en.en: What do you like doing in your free time? (to a woman)

a2-u2-l1.co-rada-robis.note.en: **rada** for a woman, **rád** for a man, as in mať rád. To someone you call vy: Čo rada robíte vo voľnom čase?
a2-u2-l1.co-rada-robis.note.t: Ayolga **rada**, erkakka **rád** deyiladi, xuddi mať rád iborasidagi kabi. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: Čo rada robíte vo voľnom čase?

a2-u2-l1.fill-co-rad-robis.en.en: What do you like doing in your free time, Tomáš?
a2-u2-l1.fill-co-rad-robis.en.t: Boʻsh vaqtingda nima qilishni yoqtirasan, Tomash?

a2-u2-l1.fill-co-rad-robis.why.en: You're asking a man, so it's **rád**. You'd ask a woman: Čo **rada** robíš…?
a2-u2-l1.fill-co-rad-robis.why.t: Siz erkakdan soʻrayapsiz, shuning uchun **rád**. Ayoldan esa shunday soʻraladi: Čo **rada** robíš…?

a2-u2-l1.konicek.note.en: Aký je tvoj koníček? = What's your hobby? Slovaks also say **hobby**, which never changes: Moje hobby je hudba. And a koníček is also a little horse (kôň)!
a2-u2-l1.konicek.note.t: Aký je tvoj koníček? = Sevimli mashgʻuloting nima? Slovaklar **hobby** ham deyishadi, bu soʻz hech oʻzgarmaydi: Moje hobby je hudba. = Mening hobbim — musiqa. Qiziq: koníček «kichkina ot» degani ham (kôň = ot)!

a2-u2-l1.kreslit-a-fotografovat.en.en: to draw and to take photos

a2-u2-l1.kreslit-a-fotografovat.note.en: kreslím, kreslíš… like robiť; fotografujem, like študovať. A photo is a **fotografia**, or a **fotka** for short.
a2-u2-l1.kreslit-a-fotografovat.note.t: kreslím, kreslíš… — robiť kabi; fotografujem — študovať kabi. Surat — **fotografia**, qisqasi **fotka**.

en: Lucia is a woman, so it's **rada**. Rád is for a man.
Lucia is **ona**, so the verb has no ending: **fotografuje**. Fotografujem is the ja form.
t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun **rada**. Rád — erkak uchun.
Lusiya — **ona** (u), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **fotografuje**. Fotografujem — ja shakli.

a2-u2-l1.oddychovat-a-pozerat.en.en: to relax and to watch TV

a2-u2-l1.oddychovat-a-pozerat.note.en: oddychujem, like študovať; pozerám, like čítať. You also hear **relaxovať**: Cez víkend relaxujem.
a2-u2-l1.oddychovat-a-pozerat.note.t: oddychujem — študovať kabi; pozerám — čítať kabi. **relaxovať** ham deyiladi: Cez víkend relaxujem. = Dam olish kunlari hordiq chiqaraman.

a2-u2-l1.fill-vecer-tomas-oddychuje.en.en: In the evening Tomáš relaxes and watches TV.
a2-u2-l1.fill-vecer-tomas-oddychuje.en.t: Kechqurun Tomash dam oladi va televizor koʻradi.

a2-u2-l1.fill-vecer-tomas-oddychuje.why.en: Tomáš is **on**, and oddychovať goes like študovať: oddych**uje**, like študuje. Oddychujem is ja, oddychujú is oni.
a2-u2-l1.fill-vecer-tomas-oddychuje.why.t: Tomash — **on** (u), oddychovať esa študovať kabi tuslanadi: oddych**uje**, študuje kabi. Oddychujem — ja, oddychujú — oni.

a2-u2-l1.hrat-na-gitare.note.en: Instruments take **na** + the where form (the locative): na **gitare**, na **klavíri** (piano), na **husliach** (violin; husle is always plural).
a2-u2-l1.hrat-na-gitare.note.t: Cholgʻu asboblari bilan **na** + lokál (oʻrin-payt kelishigi) ishlatiladi, soʻzma-soʻz «gitarada oʻynamoq»: na **gitare**, na **klavíri** (pianino), na **husliach** (skripka; husle doim koʻplikda).

a2-u2-l1.fill-marek-rad-hra.why.en: Instruments take **na** + the where form, and gitara changes -a to **-e**: na **gitare**, like v škole.
a2-u2-l1.fill-marek-rad-hra.why.t: Cholgʻu asboblari bilan **na** + lokál keladi, gitara soʻzida esa -a oʻrniga **-e** keladi: na **gitare**, v škole kabi.

a2-u2-l1.build-vecer-oddychujem-a.prompt.en: In the evening I relax and watch TV.
a2-u2-l1.build-vecer-oddychujem-a.prompt.t: Kechqurun dam olaman va televizor koʻraman.

en: The TV is what you watch, the object, so televízia changes -a to **-u**: pozerám **televíziu**.
You're talking about yourself, ja, so the verb ends in **-m**: **pozerám**. Pozerá is on or ona.
t: Televizor — siz koʻradigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun televízia soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: pozerám **televíziu**.
Siz oʻzingiz haqingizda gapiryapsiz (ja), shuning uchun feʼl **-m** bilan tugaydi, oʻzbekchadagi -man kabi: **pozerám**. Pozerá — on yoki ona.

a2-u2-l1.nakupne-centrum.note.en: The **-um** is an ending: v nákupnom **centre** (in), pred nákupným **centrom** (in front of). Two or more: **centrá**.
a2-u2-l1.nakupne-centrum.note.t: Bu yerda **-um** — qoʻshimcha, u tushib qoladi: v nákupnom **centre** (savdo markazida), pred nákupným **centrom** (savdo markazi oldida). Koʻplikda: **centrá**.

a2-u2-l1.build-sedime-v-kaviarni.prompt.en: We're sitting in a café in the shopping centre.

en: After **v** (in) comes the where form, and centrum drops -um: v **centre**, like mesto → v meste.
The adjective takes the where form too: with a neuter noun -é becomes **-om**, v **nákupnom** centre.
t: **v** dan keyin lokál keladi (oʻzbekchadagi -da kabi), centrum esa -um ni tashlaydi: v **centre**, mesto → v meste kabi.
Sifat ham lokálda keladi: oʻrta jinsdagi ot bilan -é **-om** ga aylanadi: v **nákupnom** centre.

a2-u2-l1.stretavat-sa-s.note.en: **s** + the with form (the instrumental): s priateľmi, s kamarátkami. **priateľ** = friend, a little warmer or more formal than kamarát.
a2-u2-l1.stretavat-sa-s.note.t: **s** (bilan) + inštrumentál: s priateľmi (doʻstlar bilan), s kamarátkami (dugonalar bilan). **priateľ** = doʻst; kamarát soʻzidan biroz iliqroq yoki rasmiyroq.

a2-u2-l1.choice-cez-vikend-sa.question.en: How do you say “At the weekend I meet up with friends”?
a2-u2-l1.choice-cez-vikend-sa.question.t: «Dam olish kunlari doʻstlar bilan uchrashaman» qanday aytiladi?

a2-u2-l1.choice-cez-vikend-sa.why.en: You need **s** (with), and the noun after it takes the with form, in the plural **-mi**: s **priateľmi**, like s kamarátmi.
a2-u2-l1.choice-cez-vikend-sa.why.t: **s** (bilan) kerak, undan keyingi ot esa inštrumentálda, koʻplikda **-mi** bilan keladi: s **priateľmi**, s kamarátmi kabi.

a2-u2-l1.listen-co-rada-robis.en.en: What do you like doing in your free time? (to a woman)

a2-u2-l2.rad-ta-pocujem.en.en: Good to hear from you. (a man speaking)

a2-u2-l2.rad-ta-pocujem.note.en: A warm hello on the phone (Haló?) to a friend. To someone you call vy: Rád **vás** počujem.
a2-u2-l2.rad-ta-pocujem.note.t: Telefonda (Haló?) doʻstga aytiladigan iliq salom. «Siz» deb murojaat qilinadigan odamga: Rád **vás** počujem.

a2-u2-l2.choice-ahoj-tomas-rada.question.en: Tomáš calls Lucia. How does she greet him?
a2-u2-l2.choice-ahoj-tomas-rada.question.t: Tomash Lusiyaga qoʻngʻiroq qildi. Lusiya u bilan qanday salomlashadi?

a2-u2-l2.choice-ahoj-tomas-rada.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so it's **rada**. And she's the one hearing him: **ťa** počujem, I hear you.
a2-u2-l2.choice-ahoj-tomas-rada.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun **rada**. Eshitayotgan esa Lusiyaning oʻzi: **ťa** počujem = seni eshityapman.

a2-u2-l2.mas-chut-ist.en.en: Do you fancy going to the cinema?

a2-u2-l2.mas-chut-ist.note.en: **Máš chuť** + the -ť form = do you feel like…? To vy: **Máte chuť**…? Chuť is the word in Dobrú chuť!
a2-u2-l2.mas-chut-ist.note.t: **Máš chuť** + infinitív (-ť shakli) = …ging keladimi? «Siz»ga: **Máte chuť**…? Chuť soʻzini Dobrú chuť! (Yoqimli ishtaha!) iborasidan bilasiz.

a2-u2-l2.fill-mas-chut-ist.en.en: Do you fancy going to the cinema on Saturday?

a2-u2-l2.fill-mas-chut-ist.why.en: After **máš chuť** comes the infinitive, the -ť form: máš chuť **ísť**, just like chceš ísť.
a2-u2-l2.fill-mas-chut-ist.why.t: **máš chuť** dan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť shakli keladi: máš chuť **ísť**, xuddi chceš ísť kabi.

a2-u2-l2.plavaren-a-sauna.note.en: An indoor pool is a **plaváreň**: ideme na plaváreň, sme na plavárni. A place with a pool, a sauna and massages is a **relaxačné centrum**.
a2-u2-l2.plavaren-a-sauna.note.t: Yopiq basseyn — **plaváreň**: ideme na plaváreň (basseynga boramiz), sme na plavárni (basseyndamiz). Basseyn, sauna va massaj bor joy — **relaxačné centrum** (dam olish markazi).

a2-u2-l2.build-mas-chut-ist.prompt.en: Do you fancy going to the swimming pool on Saturday? (to a friend)

en: Going there is **na** + the object form, which for plaváreň is the same as the basic form: na **plaváreň**. Na plavárni is being there.
You're asking a friend, ty, so it's **Máš** chuť. Máte is for vy.
t: U yerga borish — **na** + akuzatív; plaváreň uchun u asosiy shakl bilan bir xil: na **plaváreň** (basseynga). Na plavárni — u yerda boʻlish (basseynda).
Siz doʻstdan soʻrayapsiz (ty, sen), shuning uchun **Máš** chuť. Máte — vy (siz) uchun.

a2-u2-l2.plavky.note.en: Always plural, like noviny: Kde **sú** moje plavky?
a2-u2-l2.plavky.note.t: Doim koʻplikda, noviny kabi: Kde **sú** moje plavky? = Choʻmilish kiyimim qani?

a2-u2-l2.to-znie-dobre.note.en: Also: **To je dobrý nápad!** = That's a good idea!
a2-u2-l2.to-znie-dobre.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz «Bu yaxshi eshitiladi». Yana: **To je dobrý nápad!** = Bu yaxshi fikr!

en: Nápad (idea) is masculine, it ends in a consonant, so the adjective takes **-ý**: **dobrý** nápad.
Before a noun you need the adjective, **dobrý**. Dobre (well) goes with verbs: to znie dobre.
t: Nápad (fikr) erkak jinsida, undosh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** oladi: **dobrý** nápad.
Ot oldida sifat kerak: **dobrý**. Dobre (yaxshi, ravish) feʼllar bilan keladi: to znie dobre.

a2-u2-l2.plati.note.en: It's agreed. Casual, too: **No jasné!** = Sure! Of course!
a2-u2-l2.plati.note.t: Yaʼni kelishib olindi. Yana bir oddiy javob: **No jasné!** = Albatta! Boʻlmasam-chi!

a2-u2-l2.choice-no-jasne.question.en: Tomáš asks: “Ideš v sobotu s nami na plaváreň?” Which answer means yes?
a2-u2-l2.choice-no-jasne.question.t: Tomash soʻraydi: «Ideš v sobotu s nami na plaváreň?» Qaysi javob «ha» degani?

a2-u2-l2.mozes-s-nami.note.en: **počítať s** + the with form = to count on: Môžeš **so mnou** počítať. = You can count on me.
a2-u2-l2.mozes-s-nami.note.t: **počítať s** + inštrumentál = …ga ishonmoq, …ga tayanmoq: Môžeš **so mnou** počítať. = Menga ishonishing mumkin.

a2-u2-l2.fill-v-sobotu-no.en.en: On Saturday? Sure, you can count on me!
a2-u2-l2.fill-v-sobotu-no.en.t: Shanba kunimi? Albatta, menga ishonishing mumkin!

a2-u2-l2.fill-v-sobotu-no.why.en: **Počítať s** takes the with form, and “with me” is **so mnou**: s becomes so before mnou.
a2-u2-l2.fill-v-sobotu-no.why.t: **Počítať s** inštrumentálni talab qiladi, «men bilan» esa **so mnou**: mnou oldida s so ga aylanadi.

a2-u2-l2.build-stretneme-sa-o.prompt.en: Let's meet at ten in front of the pool.

en: **Pred** (in front of) takes the with form; feminine words without -a take **-ou**: pred **plavárňou**, like pod posteľou.
“Let's meet” is about us, my, so the verb ends in **-me**: **Stretneme** sa. Stretnem is ja.
t: **Pred** (oldida) inštrumentálni talab qiladi; -a bilan tugamaydigan ayol jinsidagi soʻzlar **-ou** oladi: pred **plavárňou**, pod posteľou kabi.
«Uchrashaylik» — biz haqimizda (my), shuning uchun feʼl **-me** bilan tugaydi: **Stretneme** sa. Stretnem — ja.

en: Will you come to the pool with us on Saturday?
Are you coming to the pool with us on Saturday?
Will you come to the swimming pool with us on Saturday?
Are you coming to the swimming pool with us on Saturday?
t: Shanba kuni biz bilan basseynga borasanmi?
Biz bilan shanba kuni basseynga borasanmi?
Shanba kuni basseynga biz bilan borasanmi?
Shanba kuni biz bilan basseynga borasizmi?

a2-u2-l2.choice-dakujem-za-pozvanie.ques.en: Emma thanks Tomáš for the invitation. What does she say?
a2-u2-l2.choice-dakujem-za-pozvanie.ques.t: Emma taklif uchun Tomashga rahmat aytadi. U nima deydi?

a2-u2-l2.choice-dakujem-za-pozvanie.why.en: You thank someone **za** something: ďakujem **za** pozvanie, like ďakujem za darček.
a2-u2-l2.choice-dakujem-za-pozvanie.why.t: Biror narsa uchun rahmat aytganda **za** ishlatiladi (oʻzbekchadagi «uchun» kabi): ďakujem **za** pozvanie, ďakujem za darček kabi.

a2-u2-l3.mas-v-piatok-cas.note.en: The everyday way to ask before you invite someone. To vy: **Máte** v piatok čas? If they can't come: **Tak nabudúce!** = Next time, then!
a2-u2-l3.mas-v-piatok-cas.note.t: Kimnidir taklif qilishdan oldin odatda shunday soʻraladi. «Siz»ga: **Máte** v piatok čas? Agar u kela olmasa: **Tak nabudúce!** = Unda keyingi safar!

a2-u2-l3.build-mas-v-sobotu.prompt.en: Are you free on Saturday? (to a friend)

en: On a day is **v** + the object form, so -a changes to -u: v **sobotu**, like v stredu.
You're asking a friend, ty, so it's **Máš**. Máte is for vy.
t: Hafta kunlari bilan **v** + akuzatív keladi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga -u: v **sobotu** (shanba kuni), v stredu kabi.
Siz doʻstdan soʻrayapsiz (ty, sen), shuning uchun **Máš**. Máte — vy (siz) uchun.

a2-u2-l3.bohuzial-nemozem.note.en: **bohužiaľ** = unfortunately; you also hear **žiaľ**. Add a reason: Bohužiaľ nemôžem, musím pracovať.
a2-u2-l3.bohuzial-nemozem.note.t: **bohužiaľ** = afsuski; **žiaľ** ham deyiladi. Sababini qoʻshing: Bohužiaľ nemôžem, musím pracovať. = Afsuski, imkonim yoʻq, ishlashim kerak.

a2-u2-l3.choice-dakujem-za-pozvanie.ques.en: Lucia invites Marek to a games evening on Friday, but he has to work. What does he say?
a2-u2-l3.choice-dakujem-za-pozvanie.ques.t: Lusiya Marekni juma kuni oʻyin kechasiga taklif qiladi, lekin u ishlashi kerak. Marek nima deydi?

a2-u2-l3.fill-dakujem-za-pozvanie.en.en: Thanks for the invitation, but I have to work on Friday.
a2-u2-l3.fill-dakujem-za-pozvanie.en.t: Taklif uchun rahmat, lekin juma kuni ishlashim kerak.

a2-u2-l3.fill-dakujem-za-pozvanie.why.en: Marek is talking about himself, ja, so musieť is **musím**. Musíš is ty, musí is on or ona.
a2-u2-l3.fill-dakujem-za-pozvanie.why.t: Marek oʻzi haqida gapiryapti (ja), shuning uchun musieť — **musím**. Musíš — ty, musí — on yoki ona.

a2-u2-l3.choice-to-je-skoda.question.en: Emma can't come on Friday. What does Lucia say to that?
a2-u2-l3.choice-to-je-skoda.question.t: Emma juma kuni kela olmaydi. Lusiya bunga nima deydi?

a2-u2-l3.upiect-tortu.note.en: upečiem, upečieš… It's one complete action, so it points to the future: **Upečiem** tortu. = I'll bake a cake. Marek can't come, but he'll bake one for the evening.
a2-u2-l3.upiect-tortu.note.t: upečiem, upečieš… Bu bir martalik, tugallangan harakat, shuning uchun kelasi zamonni bildiradi: **Upečiem** tortu. = Tort pishiraman. Marek kela olmaydi, lekin kechaga tort pishirib beradi.

a2-u2-l3.build-marek-upecie-tortu.prompt.en: Marek will bake a cake for Lucia.

en: The cake is the object, so torta changes -a to **-u**: upečie **tortu**.
**Pre** (for) takes the object form: pre **Luciu**, like pre teba.
t: Tort — toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun torta soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: upečie **tortu**.
**Pre** (uchun) akuzatívni talab qiladi: pre **Luciu** (Lusiya uchun), pre teba kabi.

a2-u2-l3.neda-sa-to.note.en: When something is impossible: V piatok o šiestej? Nedá sa to, pracujem.
a2-u2-l3.neda-sa-to.note.t: Biror narsa imkonsiz boʻlganda aytiladi: V piatok o šiestej? Nedá sa to, pracujem. = Juma kuni soat oltidami? Iloji yoʻq, ishlayman.

a2-u2-l3.build-bohuzial-nemozem-musim.pr.en: Unfortunately I can't, I have to study.
a2-u2-l3.build-bohuzial-nemozem-musim.pr.t: Afsuski, imkonim yoʻq, dars qilishim kerak.

en: You're talking about yourself, ja, so it's **nemôžem**. Nemôžeš is ty.
To study is **učiť sa**, always with sa: musím **sa** učiť.
t: Siz oʻzingiz haqingizda gapiryapsiz (ja), shuning uchun **nemôžem**. Nemôžeš — ty.
«Dars qilmoq» — **učiť sa**, doim sa bilan: musím **sa** učiť.

a2-u2-l3.ja-to-nemusim.note.en: Colloquial, and here it doesn't mean “I don't have to”: Futbal? Ja to nemusím. = Football? Not for me.
a2-u2-l3.ja-to-nemusim.note.t: Soʻzlashuv ibora; bu yerda «majbur emasman» degani emas: Futbal? Ja to nemusím. = Futbolmi? Meni qiziqtirmaydi.

en: She doesn't have to play football.

a2-u2-l3.choice-futbal-ja-to.why.en: **Ja to nemusím** is a colloquial way to say you don't like something. Only the situation tells it apart from nemusím, I don't have to.
a2-u2-l3.choice-futbal-ja-to.why.t: **Ja to nemusím** — biror narsani yoqtirmaslikni bildiradigan soʻzlashuv ibora. Uni nemusím (majbur emasman) dan faqat vaziyatga qarab ajratish mumkin.

a2-u2-l3.mam-alergiu-na.note.en: **alergia na** + the object form. Or: Som **alergická** na mačky (a man: **alergický**).
a2-u2-l3.mam-alergiu-na.note.t: **alergia na** + akuzatív (oʻzbekchadagi «…ga» kabi). Yoki: Som **alergická** na mačky (erkak: **alergický**).

a2-u2-l3.fill-lucia-je-alergicka.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so the adjective ends in **-á**: alergick**á**. Alergiu goes with mám: mám alergiu na mačky.
a2-u2-l3.fill-lucia-je-alergicka.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun sifat **-á** bilan tugaydi: alergick**á**. Alergiu esa mám bilan keladi: mám alergiu na mačky.

a2-u2-l3.choice-prepac-lucia-v.question.en: You can't come to Lucia's games evening. What do you say to her?
a2-u2-l3.choice-prepac-lucia-v.question.t: Siz Lusiyaning oʻyin kechasiga bora olmaysiz. Unga nima deysiz?

a2-u2-l3.choice-prepac-lucia-v.why.en: Lucia is a friend, so it's **prepáč** (ty); prepáčte is for vy. And you're talking about yourself: **nemôžem**.
a2-u2-l3.choice-prepac-lucia-v.why.t: Lusiya — doʻstingiz, shuning uchun **prepáč** (sen); prepáčte — vy (siz) uchun. Siz esa oʻzingiz haqingizda gapiryapsiz: **nemôžem**.

en: You know **rád** (a man), **rada** (a woman) and **radi** from A1. A group has two forms: **radi** for men or a mixed group, **rady** for women only, just like oni and ony.

Rád agrees with the person who likes, never with what they like. It works the same with a verb (Rady tancujeme.) and with mať + a noun (Máme rady hudbu.). A child (ono) takes **rado**, but you'll rarely need it.
t: **rád** (erkak), **rada** (ayol) va **radi** ni A1 dan bilasiz. Guruh uchun ikki shakl bor: **radi** — erkaklar yoki aralash guruh uchun, **rady** — faqat ayollar uchun, xuddi oni va ony kabi.

Rád yoqtirgan odamga moslashadi, yoqtirilgan narsaga emas. Feʼl bilan ham (Rady tancujeme. = Raqsga tushishni yoqtiramiz.), mať + ot bilan ham (Máme rady hudbu. = Musiqani yoqtiramiz.) shunday. Bola (ono) haqida **rado** deyiladi, lekin bu kam kerak boʻladi.
Emma va Lusiya raqsga tushishni yoqtirishadi.

en: Not liking doing something has two word orders: put ne- on rád (**Nerád** spievam.) or on the verb, with rád after it (**Nespievam** rád.). Both mean the same.
With mať, ne- goes on the verb: **Nemám rád** futbal.
t: Biror ishni qilishni yoqtirmaslikni ikki xil tartibda aytish mumkin: ne- ni rád ga qoʻshing (**Nerád** spievam.) yoki feʼlga qoʻshib, rád ni undan keyin qoʻying (**Nespievam** rád.). Ikkalasining maʼnosi bir xil: «Ashula aytishni yoqtirmayman».
mať bilan ne- feʼlga qoʻshiladi: **Nemám rád** futbal. = Futbolni yoqtirmayman.

en: I don't like loud music. (a man speaking)

a2-u2-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.en.en: Emma and Lucia like drinking coffee with milk.
a2-u2-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.en.t: Emma va Lusiya sutli qahva ichishni yoqtirishadi.

a2-u2-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.why.en: Two women are **ony**, so it's **rady**. Radi needs at least one man in the group, and rada is one woman.
a2-u2-l4.fill-emma-a-lucia.why.t: Ikki ayol — **ony**, shuning uchun **rady**. Radi uchun guruhda kamida bitta erkak boʻlishi kerak, rada esa bitta ayol.

a2-u2-l4.fill-tomas-a-emma.en.en: Tomáš and Emma like playing tennis.
a2-u2-l4.fill-tomas-a-emma.en.t: Tomash va Emma tennis oʻynashni yoqtirishadi.

a2-u2-l4.fill-tomas-a-emma.why.en: A mixed group counts as men: Tomáš and Emma are **oni**, so it's **radi**. Rady is for women only.
a2-u2-l4.fill-tomas-a-emma.why.t: Aralash guruh erkaklar kabi hisoblanadi: Tomash va Emma — **oni**, shuning uchun **radi**. Rady faqat ayollar uchun.

a2-u2-l4.choice-lucia-nema-rada.question.en: Lucia doesn't like football. Which sentence says so?
a2-u2-l4.choice-lucia-nema-rada.question.t: Lusiya futbolni yoqtirmaydi. Qaysi gap shuni aytadi?

a2-u2-l4.choice-lucia-nema-rada.why.en: With mať, ne- goes on the verb: **nemá** rada. And Lucia is a woman, so it's **rada**.
a2-u2-l4.choice-lucia-nema-rada.why.t: mať bilan ne- feʼlga qoʻshiladi: **nemá** rada. Lusiya esa ayol, shuning uchun **rada**.

a2-u2-l4.build-doma-nerad-varim.prompt.en: I don't like cooking at home. (a man speaking)

en: A man is speaking, so it's **nerád**. Nerada is for a woman.
You're talking about yourself, ja, so the verb ends in **-m**: **varím**. Varíš is ty.
t: Erkak gapiryapti, shuning uchun **nerád**. Nerada — ayol uchun.
Siz oʻzingiz haqingizda gapiryapsiz (ja), shuning uchun feʼl **-m** bilan tugaydi: **varím**. Varíš — ty.

en: To say what you like doing best, put **najradšej** with the verb: Najradšej spievam. = I like singing best. It never changes: najradšej for a man, a woman or a group.
**Radšej** means rather: Kino? Radšej pôjdem plávať. = The cinema? I'd rather go swimming.
t: Eng yoqtirgan ishingizni aytish uchun feʼl bilan **najradšej** ishlating: Najradšej spievam. = Eng koʻp ashula aytishni yoqtiraman. U hech oʻzgarmaydi: erkak, ayol yoki guruh uchun ham najradšej.
**Radšej** — «yaxshisi», «…dan koʻra»: Kino? Radšej pôjdem plávať. = Kinogami? Yaxshisi, suzishga boraman.

en: What do you like doing most?
I like dancing, but most of all I like singing. (Lucia)
t: Raqsga tushishni yoqtiraman, lekin eng koʻp ashula aytishni yoqtiraman. (Lusiya)

a2-u2-l4.fill-rad-hram-futbal.en.en: I like playing football, but most of all I like playing tennis.
a2-u2-l4.fill-rad-hram-futbal.en.t: Futbol oʻynashni yoqtiraman, lekin eng koʻp tennis oʻynashni yoqtiraman.

a2-u2-l4.fill-rad-hram-futbal.why.en: **Najradšej** marks what you like best: najradšej hrám tenis. Nerád would mean you don't like it.
a2-u2-l4.fill-rad-hram-futbal.why.t: **Najradšej** eng yoqtirgan ishni bildiradi: najradšej hrám tenis. Nerád esa «yoqtirmayman» degani boʻlardi.

a2-u2-l4.build-rady-tancujeme-a.prompt.en: We like dancing and singing. (two women speaking)
a2-u2-l4.build-rady-tancujeme-a.prompt.t: Raqsga tushishni va ashula aytishni yoqtiramiz. (ikki ayol gapiryapti)

en: Two women are speaking, so it's **rady**, for women only. Radi needs a man in the group.
t: Ikki ayol gapiryapti, shuning uchun **rady** — faqat ayollar uchun. Radi uchun guruhda erkak boʻlishi kerak.

a2-u2-l4.choice-emma-a-lucia-maju.why.en: Two women are **ony**: the verb is **majú** and rád becomes **rady**.
a2-u2-l4.choice-emma-a-lucia-maju.why.t: Ikki ayol — **ony**: feʼl **majú**, rád esa **rady** boʻladi.

a2-u2-l4.fill-pan-kovac-nema.en.en: Mr Kováč doesn't like loud music.

a2-u2-l4.fill-pan-kovac-nema.why.en: Pán Kováč is **on**, so mať is **má**, and ne- goes on the verb: **nemá** rád.
a2-u2-l4.fill-pan-kovac-nema.why.t: Janob Kovach — **on** (u), shuning uchun mať — **má**, ne- esa feʼlga qoʻshiladi: **nemá** rád.

en: What do you like doing most, Emma?
What do you like doing best, Emma?
What do you like to do most, Emma?
t: Eng koʻp nima qilishni yoqtirasan, Emma?
Emma, eng koʻp nima qilishni yoqtirasan?
Nima qilishni eng koʻp yoqtirasan, Emma?

a2-u2-l4.build-tomas-nerad-cita.prompt.en: Tomáš doesn't like reading the paper.

en: Tomáš is a man, so it's **nerád**. Nerada is for a woman.
Tomáš is one person, on, so the verb has no ending: **číta**. Čítajú is oni.
t: Tomash — erkak, shuning uchun **nerád**. Nerada — ayol uchun.
Tomash — bitta odam (on), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **číta**. Čítajú — oni.

a2-u2-l5.sportovat.note.en: športujem, športuješ… like študovať. Športuješ? = Do you do any sport?
a2-u2-l5.sportovat.note.t: športujem, športuješ… — študovať kabi. Športuješ? = Sport bilan shugʻullanasanmi?

a2-u2-l5.bicyklovat-sa.note.en: bicyklujem sa, like študovať, with sa. And **behať** = to run: behám, beháš… Ráno behám v parku.
a2-u2-l5.bicyklovat-sa.note.t: bicyklujem sa — študovať kabi, faqat sa bilan. **behať** esa = yugurmoq: behám, beháš… Ráno behám v parku. = Ertalab parkda yuguraman.

a2-u2-l5.hrat-volejbal.note.en: Sports and games take the object form, with no na: hrať **futbal**, **tenis**, **basketbal**. Na is for instruments: hrať **na** gitare.
a2-u2-l5.hrat-volejbal.note.t: Sport va oʻyinlar bilan na qoʻyilmaydi, ular akuzatívda keladi: hrať **futbal**, **tenis**, **basketbal**. Na esa cholgʻu asboblari uchun: hrať **na** gitare.

a2-u2-l5.fill-marek-hra-na.en.en: Marek plays the guitar and Tomáš plays tennis.
a2-u2-l5.fill-marek-hra-na.en.t: Marek gitara chaladi, Tomash esa tennis oʻynaydi.

a2-u2-l5.fill-marek-hra-na.why.en: Sports take the object form with no preposition: hrá **tenis**. Na + the where form is only for instruments: na gitare.
a2-u2-l5.fill-marek-hra-na.why.t: Sport turlari predlogsiz, akuzatívda keladi: hrá **tenis**. Na + lokál faqat cholgʻu asboblari uchun: na gitare.

a2-u2-l5.plavec-plavkyna.note.en: From plávať. Also **športovec, športovkyňa** (sportsman, sportswoman), **lyžiar, lyžiarka** (skier) and **tenista, tenistka** (tennis player). **výborný** = excellent.
a2-u2-l5.plavec-plavkyna.note.t: plávať soʻzidan. Yana: **športovec, športovkyňa** (sportchi erkak, sportchi ayol), **lyžiar, lyžiarka** (changʻichi) va **tenista, tenistka** (tennischi). **výborný** = aʼlo, juda yaxshi.

a2-u2-l5.choice-si-vyborna-plavkyna.ques.en: Emma swims really well. What does Tomáš tell her?
a2-u2-l5.choice-si-vyborna-plavkyna.ques.t: Emma juda yaxshi suzadi. Tomash unga nima deydi?

a2-u2-l5.choice-si-vyborna-plavkyna.why.en: Emma is a woman, so she's a **plavkyňa**, and the adjective agrees: výborn**á**. Plavky is a swimsuit.
a2-u2-l5.choice-si-vyborna-plavkyna.why.t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun u **plavkyňa**, sifat ham moslashadi: výborn**á**. Plavky esa choʻmilish kiyimi.

a2-u2-l5.fill-lucia-nie-je.en.en: Lucia isn't much of a sportswoman, but Tomáš is a good skier.
a2-u2-l5.fill-lucia-nie-je.en.t: Lusiya uncha sportchi emas, Tomash esa yaxshi changʻichi.

a2-u2-l5.fill-lucia-nie-je.why.en: Lucia is a woman, so it's **športovkyňa**, like plavkyňa. Športovec is for a man, and športovať is the verb.
a2-u2-l5.fill-lucia-nie-je.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun **športovkyňa**, plavkyňa kabi. Športovec — erkak uchun, športovať esa feʼl.

a2-u2-l5.cerstvy-vzduch.note.en: You know čerstvý from čerstvý chlieb. Na čerstvom vzduchu = out in the fresh air.
a2-u2-l5.cerstvy-vzduch.note.t: čerstvý soʻzini čerstvý chlieb (yangi non) dan bilasiz. Na čerstvom vzduchu = ochiq havoda, toza havoda.

en: Vzduch is masculine, it ends in a consonant, so the adjective takes **-ý**: **čerstvý** vzduch.
Pán Kováč is a man, so it's **rád**. Rada is for a woman.
t: Vzduch erkak jinsida, undosh bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** oladi: **čerstvý** vzduch.
Janob Kovach — erkak, shuning uchun **rád**. Rada — ayol uchun.

a2-u2-l5.cvicit-jogu.note.en: cvičím, cvičíš… like robiť. **cvičiť** on its own = to exercise, to work out. A gym is a **fitnes** (or posilňovňa), and the pool itself is a **bazén**.
a2-u2-l5.cvicit-jogu.note.t: cvičím, cvičíš… — robiť kabi. Toʻldiruvchisiz **cvičiť** = mashq qilmoq, badantarbiya qilmoq. Sport zali — **fitnes** (yoki posilňovňa), basseyndagi suv havzasining oʻzi esa — **bazén**.

a2-u2-l5.fill-emma-a-lucia-cvicia.en.t: Emma va Lusiya yoga bilan shugʻullanishadi.

a2-u2-l5.fill-emma-a-lucia-cvicia.why.en: Emma and Lucia are **ony**, and cvičiť goes like robiť: cvič**ia**, like robia. Cvičí is one person, cvičíme is my.
a2-u2-l5.fill-emma-a-lucia-cvicia.why.t: Emma va Lusiya — **ony** (ular), cvičiť esa robiť kabi tuslanadi: cvič**ia**, robia kabi. Cvičí — bitta odam, cvičíme — my.

en: Lucia is **ona**, so the verb has no ending: **cvičí**. Cvičím is ja.
Yoga is what she does, the object, so joga changes -a to **-u**: cvičí **jogu**.
t: Lusiya — **ona** (u), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **cvičí**. Cvičím — ja.
Yoga — u qiladigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun joga soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: cvičí **jogu**.

a2-u2-l5.lyzovat-sa.note.en: lyžujem sa. You need **lyže** (skis) and **sneh** (snow). On a board: **snowboardovať sa**. A ski resort is a **lyžiarske stredisko**.
a2-u2-l5.lyzovat-sa.note.t: lyžujem sa. Buning uchun **lyže** (changʻi) va **sneh** (qor) kerak. Snoubordda: **snowboardovať sa**. Changʻi kurorti — **lyžiarske stredisko**.

a2-u2-l5.build-v-zime-sa.prompt.en: In winter Tomáš skis in the Tatras.
a2-u2-l5.build-v-zime-sa.prompt.t: Qishda Tomash Tatra togʻlarida changʻi uchadi.

en: Tomáš is **on**, so the verb ends in **-e**: **lyžuje**. Lyžujem is ja.
To ski is **lyžovať sa**, always with sa: Tomáš **sa** lyžuje.
t: Tomash — **on** (u), shuning uchun feʼl **-e** bilan tugaydi: **lyžuje**. Lyžujem — ja.
«Changʻi uchmoq» — **lyžovať sa**, doim sa bilan: Tomáš **sa** lyžuje.

a2-u2-l5.fill-v-tatrach-uz.en.en: There's already snow in the Tatras, and Tomáš is going skiing.
a2-u2-l5.fill-v-tatrach-uz.en.t: Tatra togʻlarida allaqachon qor bor, Tomash changʻi uchgani ketyapti.

a2-u2-l5.fill-v-tatrach-uz.why.en: The snow is the subject of je, so it stays in the basic form: **sneh**.
a2-u2-l5.fill-v-tatrach-uz.why.t: Qor — je feʼlining egasi, shuning uchun asosiy shaklda (nominatív) qoladi: **sneh**.

a2-u2-l5.choice-neviem-sa-lyzovat.questi.en: Emma has never learned to ski. How does she say “I can't ski”?
a2-u2-l5.choice-neviem-sa-lyzovat.questi.t: Emma hech qachon changʻi uchishni oʻrganmagan. «Changʻi ucha olmayman»ni qanday aytadi?

a2-u2-l5.choice-neviem-sa-lyzovat.why.en: “Can” as in “know how to” is **vedieť**: **neviem** sa lyžovať. Nemôžem means something stops you; nemusím, that you don't have to.
a2-u2-l5.choice-neviem-sa-lyzovat.why.t: «Ucha olmayman» «bilmayman» maʼnosida boʻlsa — **vedieť**: **neviem** sa lyžovať (changʻi uchishni bilmayman). Nemôžem — biror narsa xalaqit beryapti; nemusím — majbur emasman.

a2-u2-l5.speak-rano-beham-v.en.en: I go running in the park in the morning.

a2-u2-l6.korculovat-sa.note.en: korčuľujem sa, like lyžovať sa. You need **korčule** (skates); on wheels, **kolieskové korčule**. Neviem sa korčuľovať, ale chcem sa **naučiť**. = I can't skate, but I want to learn.
a2-u2-l6.korculovat-sa.note.t: korčuľujem sa — lyžovať sa kabi. Buning uchun **korčule** (konki) kerak; gʻildirakli konki (rolik) — **kolieskové korčule**. Neviem sa korčuľovať, ale chcem sa **naučiť**. = Konkida uchishni bilmayman, lekin oʻrganmoqchiman.

a2-u2-l6.fill-emma-sa-chce.en.en: Emma wants to learn to skate.

a2-u2-l6.fill-emma-sa-chce.why.en: After **chce** comes the infinitive, the -ť form: chce sa **naučiť**.
a2-u2-l6.fill-emma-sa-chce.why.t: **chce** dan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť shakli keladi: chce sa **naučiť**.

a2-u2-l6.zimny-stadion.note.en: Literally “winter stadium”: an indoor rink. Emma má kurz korčuľovania na zimnom štadióne. (**kurz** = course)
a2-u2-l6.zimny-stadion.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz «qishki stadion»: yopiq muz maydoni. Emma má kurz korčuľovania na zimnom štadióne. = Emma muz maydonida konkida uchish kursiga qatnaydi. (**kurz** = kurs)

a2-u2-l6.build-vo-stvrtok-ide.prompt.en: On Thursday Emma is going to the ice rink.
a2-u2-l6.build-vo-stvrtok-ide.prompt.t: Payshanba kuni Emma muz maydoniga boradi.

en: Going there is **na** + the object form, which for a masculine thing is the basic form: na **štadión**. Na štadióne is being there.
Going there takes the object form, so the adjective stays **zimný**. Zimnom is the where form: na zimnom štadióne.
t: U yerga borish — **na** + akuzatív; erkak jinsidagi narsa uchun u asosiy shakl bilan bir xil: na **štadión** (stadionga). Na štadióne — u yerda boʻlish (stadionda).
Borish akuzatívni talab qiladi, shuning uchun sifat **zimný** boʻlib qoladi. Zimnom — lokál: na zimnom štadióne (muz maydonida).

a2-u2-l6.spadnut.note.en: Past: **spadol, spadla**, like zabudnúť → zabudol. Spadla som! = I fell!
a2-u2-l6.spadnut.note.t: Oʻtgan zamon: **spadol, spadla**, zabudnúť → zabudol kabi. Spadla som! = Yiqildim! (ayol gapiryapti)

a2-u2-l6.modrina.note.en: From modrý (blue). Mám veľkú modrinu. = I've got a big bruise.
a2-u2-l6.modrina.note.t: modrý (koʻk) soʻzidan, xuddi oʻzbekchadagi «koʻkarish» kabi. Mám veľkú modrinu. = Katta koʻkarishim bor.

a2-u2-l6.fill-emma-spadla-a.en.en: Emma fell and has a big bruise.
a2-u2-l6.fill-emma-spadla-a.en.t: Emma yiqilib tushdi, endi katta koʻkarishi bor.

a2-u2-l6.fill-emma-spadla-a.why.en: Emma is a woman, so the past ends in **-la**. Like stretnúť → stretla, spadnúť swaps -núť for -la or -ol: spad**la**, spad**ol**.
a2-u2-l6.fill-emma-spadla-a.why.t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi. stretnúť → stretla kabi, spadnúť ham -núť oʻrniga -la yoki -ol oladi: spad**la**, spad**ol**.

a2-u2-l6.som-uplne-hotova.en.en: I'm completely worn out. (a woman speaking)

a2-u2-l6.som-uplne-hotova.note.t: Juda charchaganni bildiradigan soʻzlashuv ibora (unavená = charchagan). **úplne** = butunlay, mutlaqo.

a2-u2-l6.choice-som-uplne-hotova.why.en: **Hotový** often means ready or finished, but **som (úplne) hotová** is slang for very tired, unavená.
a2-u2-l6.choice-som-uplne-hotova.why.t: **Hotový** koʻpincha «tayyor» yoki «tugagan» degani, lekin **som (úplne) hotová** — «juda charchadim» degan soʻzlashuv ibora, unavená maʼnosida.

a2-u2-l6.fill-tomas-sa-korculoval.en.en: Tomáš skated for two hours and he's completely worn out.
a2-u2-l6.fill-tomas-sa-korculoval.en.t: Tomash ikki soat konkida uchdi va butunlay holdan toydi.

a2-u2-l6.fill-tomas-sa-korculoval.why.en: Tomáš is a man, so the adjective ends in **-ý**: hotov**ý**. Hotová is for a woman.
a2-u2-l6.fill-tomas-sa-korculoval.why.t: Tomash — erkak, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** bilan tugaydi: hotov**ý**. Hotová — ayol uchun.

a2-u2-l6.poziciias-mi-korcule.en.en: Will you lend me your skates?

a2-u2-l6.poziciias-mi-korcule.note.en: **požičať** = to lend: požičiam, požičiaš… To a friend, add **prosím ťa** to make it polite: Prosím ťa, požičiaš mi korčule?
a2-u2-l6.poziciias-mi-korcule.note.t: **požičať** = qarzga bermoq, berib turmoq: požičiam, požičiaš… Doʻstdan xushmuomala bilan soʻrash uchun **prosím ťa** qoʻshing: Prosím ťa, požičiaš mi korčule? = Iltimos, konkingni berib turasanmi?

a2-u2-l6.build-prosim-ta-poziciias.promp.en: Could you lend me your skates, please? (to a friend)

en: You're asking a friend, ty, so it's prosím **ťa**. Prosím vás is for vy.
You're asking the other person, ty, so the verb ends in **-š**: **požičiaš**. Požičiam is ja.
t: Siz doʻstdan soʻrayapsiz (ty, sen), shuning uchun prosím **ťa**. Prosím vás — vy (siz) uchun.
Siz suhbatdoshdan soʻrayapsiz (ty), shuning uchun feʼl **-š** bilan tugaydi, oʻzbekchadagi -san kabi: **požičiaš**. Požičiam — ja.

en: I can already skate a little!

a2-u2-l7.titleEn.t: Suzish, rasm chizish: feʼldan yasalgan otlar

en: Slovak makes a noun from almost any verb: drop **-ť** and add **-nie**. Verbs in -ať give -anie, verbs in -iť give **-enie**: plávať → plávanie, kresliť → kreslenie. **Sa** drops: lyžovať sa → lyžovanie.
All these nouns are neuter (ono). A few short verbs take **-tie** instead: piť → pitie, as in A na pitie? You know stretnutie (a meeting) too: it comes from stretnúť.
t: Slovak tilida deyarli har bir feʼldan ot yasash mumkin, xuddi oʻzbekchadagi -sh / -ish kabi (suzmoq → suzish): **-ť** ni tashlab, **-nie** qoʻshiladi. -ať feʼllardan -anie, -iť feʼllardan **-enie** chiqadi: plávať → plávanie, kresliť → kreslenie. **Sa** tushib qoladi: lyžovať sa → lyžovanie.

Bu otlarning hammasi oʻrta jinsda (ono). Baʼzi qisqa feʼllar buning oʻrniga **-tie** oladi: piť → pitie, «A na pitie?» (Ichimlikka-chi?) savolidagi kabi. stretnutie (uchrashuv) ni ham bilasiz: u stretnúť dan yasalgan.

t: Konkida uchish — Emma uchun yangi mashgʻulot.

a2-u2-l7.grammar-moj-konicek-je.title.en: Môj koníček je… / Mojím koníčkom je…
a2-u2-l7.grammar-moj-konicek-je.title.t: Môj koníček je… / Mojím koníčkom je…

en: To name your hobby, say **Môj koníček je** plávanie. Just as common, and a little more formal, is **Mojím koníčkom je** plávanie: here môj and koníček both take the with form (the instrumental), as in stať sa lekárom.
**Hobby** never changes: Moje hobby je varenie. / Mojím hobby je varenie.
t: Sevimli mashgʻulotingizni aytish uchun: **Môj koníček je** plávanie. = Mening sevimli mashgʻulotim — suzish. Xuddi shunchalik koʻp ishlatiladigan, biroz rasmiyroq shakl: **Mojím koníčkom je** plávanie. Bu yerda môj ham, koníček ham inštrumentálda keladi, stať sa lekárom (shifokor boʻlmoq) dagi kabi.
**Hobby** hech oʻzgarmaydi: Moje hobby je varenie. / Mojím hobby je varenie.

a2-u2-l7.fill-moj-konicek-je.why.en: After **koníček je** you need a noun, the -nie form: **plávanie**. Plávať is the verb.
a2-u2-l7.fill-moj-konicek-je.why.t: **koníček je** dan keyin ot kerak, yaʼni -nie shakli: **plávanie** (suzish). Plávať — feʼl (suzmoq).

a2-u2-l7.choice-varenie.question.en: Which noun comes from variť (to cook)?
a2-u2-l7.choice-varenie.question.t: variť (ovqat pishirmoq) feʼlidan qaysi ot yasaladi?

a2-u2-l7.choice-varenie.why.en: Verbs in **-iť** give **-enie**: var**enie**, like kresliť → kreslenie.
a2-u2-l7.choice-varenie.why.t: **-iť** bilan tugaydigan feʼllardan **-enie** chiqadi: var**enie**, kresliť → kreslenie kabi.

a2-u2-l7.fill-mojim-konickom-je.why.en: With **mojím**, koníček takes the with form too: mojím **koníčkom**. The two go together.
a2-u2-l7.fill-mojim-konickom-je.why.t: **mojím** bilan koníček ham inštrumentálda keladi: mojím **koníčkom**. Ikkalasi birga oʻzgaradi.

en: After **koníček je** comes a noun, and sa drops: lyžovať sa → **lyžovanie**.
t: **koníček je** dan keyin ot keladi, sa esa tushib qoladi: lyžovať sa → **lyžovanie**.

en: These nouns take the endings of poschodie and oddelenie, which you know: **-í** after o, v, na, pri (o plávaní) and **-ím** after s (s plávaním).
After **kurz** (a course) they end in **-ia**: kurz plávania, kurz korčuľovania. Learn it as a phrase for now.
t: Bu otlar sizga tanish poschodie va oddelenie soʻzlarining qoʻshimchalarini oladi: o, v, na, pri dan keyin **-í** (o plávaní = suzish haqida), s dan keyin **-ím** (s plávaním).
**kurz** (kurs) dan keyin ular **-ia** bilan tugaydi: kurz plávania (suzish kursi), kurz korčuľovania. Hozircha buni tayyor ibora sifatida yodlang.

a2-u2-l7.fill-pani-horvathova-rada.en.en: Mrs Horváthová likes reading about travelling.
a2-u2-l7.fill-pani-horvathova-rada.en.t: Horvatova xonim sayohat haqida oʻqishni yoqtiradi.

a2-u2-l7.fill-pani-horvathova-rada.why.en: After **o** (about) comes the where form, which for these nouns ends in **-í**, like o poschodí: o cestovan**í**.
a2-u2-l7.fill-pani-horvathova-rada.why.t: **o** (haqida) dan keyin lokál keladi, bu otlarda u **-í** bilan tugaydi, o poschodí kabi: o cestovan**í**.

t: **koníček je** dan keyin ot keladi: fotografovať → **fotografovanie**.
Koníček erkak jinsida, shuning uchun «Lusiyaning» — **Luciin**, qoʻshimchasiz, Tomášov stôl kabi. Luciina ayol jinsidagi soʻzlar bilan keladi.

a2-u2-l7.choice-plavanie-je-zdrave.why.en: Nouns in -nie are neuter, so the adjective ends in **-é**: zdrav**é**, like Auto je malé.
a2-u2-l7.choice-plavanie-je-zdrave.why.t: -nie bilan tugaydigan otlar oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: zdrav**é**, Auto je malé kabi.

a2-u2-l8.build-v-nedelu-ideme.prompt.en: On Sunday we're going to the zoo.

“We” is my, so ísť is **ideme**. Idú is oni.
t: Hafta kunlari bilan **v** + akuzatív keladi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga -u: v **nedeľu** (yakshanba kuni), v stredu kabi.
«Biz» — my, shuning uchun ísť — **ideme**. Idú — oni.

a2-u2-l8.fill-pani-horvathova-ma.why.en: Zviera has a special plural, zvier**atá**, and liking animals in general takes the plural, as in mám rada filmy.
a2-u2-l8.fill-pani-horvathova-ma.why.t: Zviera soʻzining koʻpligi oʻziga xos: zvier**atá**. Umuman hayvonlarni yoqtirish koʻplik bilan aytiladi, mám rada filmy kabi.

a2-u2-l8.vystava.note.en: In a **galéria** (gallery) or a múzeum: ísť na výstavu. Pani Horváthová rada chodí na výstavy.

a2-u2-l8.fill-v-sobotu-idem.en.en: On Saturday I'm going to an exhibition at the gallery.

a2-u2-l8.fill-v-sobotu-idem.why.t: Tadbirga borish — **na** + akuzatív, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga -u keladi: na **výstavu**, na oslavu kabi.

Bu yerda koʻrgazma — ega, shuning uchun asosiy shaklda qoladi: **Výstava** je…

en: Two everyday verbs for “take”, each with its own pattern. **brať** (beriem…) is taking in general, or again and again. **vziať** (vezmem…) is one complete action, so like kúpiť it points to the future: **Vezmem** si plavky. = I'll take my swimsuit.

Like brať: **zobrať** (zoberiem, the same as vziať), **vybrať** (vyberiem, to choose; vybrať peniaze z bankomatu, to take money out of a cash machine) and **prať** (periem, to do the washing). Like vziať: **začať** (začnem, to begin) and **prijať** (prijmem, to accept).
t: «Olmoq» uchun ikkita kundalik feʼl bor, har birining oʻz tuslanishi bor. **brať** (beriem…) — umuman olish yoki qayta-qayta olish. **vziať** (vezmem…) — bir martalik, tugallangan harakat, shuning uchun kúpiť kabi kelasi zamonni bildiradi: **Vezmem** si plavky. = Choʻmilish kiyimimni olaman.

brať kabi: **zobrať** (zoberiem, vziať bilan bir maʼnoda), **vybrať** (vyberiem, tanlamoq; vybrať peniaze z bankomatu — bankomatdan pul yechmoq) va **prať** (periem, kir yuvmoq). vziať kabi: **začať** (začnem, boshlamoq) va **prijať** (prijmem, qabul qilmoq).

en: **pozrieť** goes like smieť (smiem, smieš…): pozriem, pozrieš… **pozrieť sa na** + the object form is to look at: Pozriem sa na program. **pozrieť si** is to watch or check something for yourself: Pozrieme si film.
**minúť** (to spend money or time) goes miniem, minieš… So does **plynúť** (to pass, of time): Čas rýchlo plynie. Pozrieť and minúť are one complete action, so they point to the future.
t: **pozrieť** smieť kabi tuslanadi (smiem, smieš…): pozriem, pozrieš… **pozrieť sa na** + akuzatív = …ga qaramoq: Pozriem sa na program. = Dasturga qarab chiqaman. **pozrieť si** = oʻzi uchun biror narsani tomosha qilmoq yoki koʻrib chiqmoq: Pozrieme si film. = Film koʻramiz.

**minúť** (pul yoki vaqt sarflamoq): miniem, minieš… **plynúť** (vaqt haqida: oʻtmoq) ham shunday: Čas rýchlo plynie. = Vaqt tez oʻtadi. Pozrieť va minúť — tugallangan tur, shuning uchun kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

a2-u2-l9.fill-co-si-vezmes.en.en: What will you take on the trip, Emma?

a2-u2-l9.fill-pozrieme-si-v.en.en: Shall we watch the new film on Saturday?

a2-u2-l9.fill-emma-sa-pozrie.en.en: Emma will have a look at the programme.

a2-u2-l9.choice-prijmes-pozvanie.why.en: **Prijať** is to accept. Like vziať, it's one complete action, so prijm**eš** points to the future: will you accept?

a2-u2-l10.zbierat.note.t: zbieram, zbieraš… Kolleksiya — **zbierka**. **ukázať** = koʻrsatmoq: Ukážem ti moju zbierku. = Senga kolleksiyamni koʻrsataman.

a2-u2-l10.postova-znamka.note.en: Or just **známka**: známky. A **pohľadnica** is a postcard: **Kedysi** som zbierala pohľadnice. = I used to collect postcards.

a2-u2-l10.spolocenska-hra.note.en: Plural: **spoločenské hry**. **pravidlá hry** = the rules of the game.

a2-u2-l10.fill-v-piatok-hrame.en.en: On Friday we're playing board games.

a2-u2-l10.fill-v-piatok-hrame.why.en: Spoločenské, with -é, shows it's plural, so it's **hry**: hra → hry, like rieka → rieky.
a2-u2-l10.fill-v-piatok-hrame.why.t: -é bilan tugagan spoločenské koʻplikni koʻrsatadi, shuning uchun **hry**: hra → hry, rieka → rieky kabi.

a2-u2-l10.zlozity.note.en: Pravidlá sú zložité. = The rules are complicated. The opposite is **jednoduchý** (simple).
a2-u2-l10.zlozity.note.t: Pravidlá sú zložité. = Qoidalar murakkab. Uning teskarisi — **jednoduchý** (oddiy).

a2-u2-l10.fill-ta-hra-ma.en.en: That game has very complicated rules.

a2-u2-l10.fill-ta-hra-ma.why.en: Pravidlá is plural, so the adjective ends in **-é**: zložit**é** pravidlá, like nové mestá.
a2-u2-l10.fill-ta-hra-ma.why.t: Pravidlá — koʻplik, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: zložit**é** pravidlá, nové mestá kabi.

a2-u2-l10.build-pravidla-hry-su.prompt.en: The rules of the game are simple.

en: Pravidlá (the rules) is plural, so byť is **sú**.
Pravidlá is plural, so the adjective ends in **-é**: **jednoduché**.
t: Pravidlá — koʻplik, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: **jednoduché**.

en: I haven't played chess for ages.
I haven't played chess for a long time.
I haven't played chess in ages.
I haven't played chess in a long time.

When the owner is the subject of the sentence, Slovak says **svoj** for his, her or their: Tomáš prinesie **svoj** šach. = Tomáš will bring his (own) chess set. (**priniesť** = to bring: prinesiem, prinesieš…)
With **jeho**, **jej** or **ich**, the thing belongs to someone else: Tomáš prinesie **jeho** šach is another man's chess set. With ja and ty, môj and tvoj are fine too: Prinesiem svoju / moju hru.
t: Narsa gapning egasiga tegishli boʻlsa, slovak tilida jeho, jej yoki ich oʻrniga **svoj** ishlatiladi, xuddi oʻzbekchadagi «oʻz» kabi: Tomáš prinesie **svoj** šach. = Tomash oʻz shaxmatini olib keladi. (**priniesť** = olib kelmoq: prinesiem, prinesieš…)

**jeho**, **jej** yoki **ich** bilan narsa boshqa odamga tegishli: Tomáš prinesie **jeho** šach — Tomash boshqa bir erkakning shaxmatini olib keladi. ja va ty bilan môj va tvoj ham toʻgʻri: Prinesiem svoju / moju hru. = Oʻyinimni olib kelaman.

en: Tomáš will bring his chess set.
Lucia is looking for her (own) cards.
Lucia is looking for her cards. (another woman's)
Svoj takes the same endings as môj. It never goes with the subject itself, so it has no nominative: svoj šach is always an object.
Before svoj, s becomes **so**: so svojím bratom.
t: Svoj môj bilan bir xil qoʻshimchalarni oladi. U hech qachon gap egasining oʻzi bilan kelmaydi, shuning uchun uning nominatív (bosh kelishik) shakli yoʻq: svoj šach doim toʻldiruvchi boʻladi.
svoj oldida s **so** ga aylanadi: so svojím bratom (oʻz akasi bilan).

en: Emma is talking about her brother.
Lucia is playing chess with her brother.
t: Lusiya oʻz akasi bilan shaxmat oʻynayapti.

a2-u2-l11.fill-pan-kovac-prinesie.en.en: Mr Kováč will bring his chess set.
a2-u2-l11.fill-pan-kovac-prinesie.en.t: Janob Kovach oʻz shaxmatini olib keladi.

a2-u2-l11.fill-pan-kovac-prinesie.why.en: It's his own chess set and he's the subject, so it's **svoj**. Jeho šach would be another man's, and svoju goes with feminine words.
a2-u2-l11.fill-pan-kovac-prinesie.why.t: Shaxmat uning oʻziniki, u esa gapning egasi, shuning uchun **svoj**. Jeho šach — boshqa erkakning shaxmati boʻlardi, svoju esa ayol jinsidagi soʻzlar bilan keladi.

a2-u2-l11.choice-lucia-hlada-jej.questio.en: Whose phone is Lucia looking for?

a2-u2-l11.choice-lucia-hlada-jej.why.en: With **jej**, the phone belongs to another woman. Her own phone would be **svoj** mobil, because Lucia is the subject.
a2-u2-l11.choice-lucia-hlada-jej.why.t: **jej** bilan telefon boshqa ayolga tegishli. Oʻz telefoni boʻlsa, **svoj** mobil boʻlardi, chunki Lusiya — gapning egasi.

a2-u2-l11.fill-prinesies-svoju-gitaru.wh.en: Gitaru is the object, so svoj takes the object ending, like moju: **svoju** gitaru.
a2-u2-l11.fill-prinesies-svoju-gitaru.wh.t: Gitaru — toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun svoj ham akuzatív qoʻshimchasini oladi, moju kabi: **svoju** gitaru.

a2-u2-l11.build-emma-telefonuje-so.promp.en: Emma is on the phone to her mum.
a2-u2-l11.build-emma-telefonuje-so.promp.t: Emma oʻz onasi bilan telefonda gaplashyapti.

en: Before svoj-, s becomes **so**: **so** svojou mamou.
Emma is the subject and it's her own mum, so it's **svojou**. Jej mamou would be another woman's mum.
t: svoj- oldida s **so** ga aylanadi: **so** svojou mamou.
Emma — gapning egasi, ona ham oʻzining onasi, shuning uchun **svojou**. Jej mamou — boshqa ayolning onasi boʻlardi.

en: In the plural, as an object: **svoje** for things, women and animals, **svojich** for men. After s, it's **so svojimi** for all of them.
t: Koʻplikda, toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda: narsalar, ayollar va hayvonlar uchun **svoje**, erkaklar uchun **svojich**. s dan keyin hammasi uchun **so svojimi**.

en: Tomáš will come with his friends.

a2-u2-l11.fill-emma-hlada-svoje.en.en: Emma is looking for her skates.

a2-u2-l11.fill-emma-hlada-svoje.why.en: Korčule is plural, and things take **svoje**. Svojich is for men, svoju for one feminine thing.
a2-u2-l11.fill-emma-hlada-svoje.why.t: Korčule — koʻplik, narsalar uchun esa **svoje**. Svojich — erkaklar uchun, svoju — ayol jinsidagi bitta narsa uchun.

a2-u2-l11.fill-emma-pride-so.en.en: Emma will come with her friends.

a2-u2-l11.fill-emma-pride-so.why.en: After **so** (with), the plural takes **svojimi**, like s kamarátkami.
a2-u2-l11.fill-emma-pride-so.why.t: **so** (bilan) dan keyin koʻplikda **svojimi** keladi, s kamarátkami kabi.

en: Kamaráti are men, and men as objects take **svojich**, like kamarátov.
Men in the plural as objects end in **-ov**: **kamarátov**.
t: Kamaráti — erkaklar, toʻldiruvchi boʻlgan erkaklar bilan esa **svojich** keladi, kamarátov kabi.
Koʻplikdagi erkaklar toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda **-ov** bilan tugaydi: **kamarátov**.

a2-u2-l11.choice-emma-hovori-o.question.en: Emma is talking about her own brother. Which sentence is right?
a2-u2-l11.choice-emma-hovori-o.question.t: Emma oʻz akasi haqida gapiryapti. Qaysi gap toʻgʻri?

a2-u2-l11.choice-emma-hovori-o.why.en: It's Emma's own brother and she's the subject, so it's svoj; after **o** comes the where form: o **svojom** bratovi.
a2-u2-l11.choice-emma-hovori-o.why.t: Bu Emmaning oʻz akasi, u esa gapning egasi, shuning uchun svoj; **o** dan keyin lokál keladi: o **svojom** bratovi.

a2-u2-l11.fill-pan-kovac-ukaze.en.en: Mr Kováč will show his stamps.

a2-u2-l11.fill-pan-kovac-ukaze.why.en: Známky are things in the plural, so it's **svoje**. Svojich is for men.
a2-u2-l11.fill-pan-kovac-ukaze.why.t: Známky — koʻplikdagi narsalar, shuning uchun **svoje**. Svojich — erkaklar uchun.

a2-u2-l12.nechat.note.en: nechám, necháš… Marek nechal tortu na vrátnici. = Marek left the cake at the porter's desk.
a2-u2-l12.nechat.note.t: nechám, necháš… Marek nechal tortu na vrátnici. = Marek tortni qorovulxonada qoldirdi.

a2-u2-l12.fill-v-piatok-o.en.en: On Friday at five, Marek left the cake at the porter's desk.
a2-u2-l12.fill-v-piatok-o.en.t: Juma kuni soat beshda Marek tortni qorovulxonada qoldirdi.

a2-u2-l12.fill-v-piatok-o.why.en: Marek is a man, so the past tense ends in **-l**: nechal. Nechala is for a woman.
a2-u2-l12.fill-v-piatok-o.why.t: Marek — erkak, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-l** bilan tugaydi: nechal. Nechala — ayol uchun.

a2-u2-l12.mimochodom.note.en: Mimochodom, kde je torta? = By the way, where's the cake?
a2-u2-l12.mimochodom.note.t: Mimochodom, kde je torta? = Aytgancha, tort qani?

en: By the way, where's the cake?

a2-u2-l12.prazdna-krabica.note.en: **prázdny** = empty, **krabica** = box. Na vrátnici je **len** prázdna krabica. = There's only an empty box at the desk. (len = only)
a2-u2-l12.prazdna-krabica.note.t: **prázdny** = boʻsh, **krabica** = quti. Na vrátnici je **len** prázdna krabica. = Qorovulxonada faqat boʻsh quti bor. (len = faqat)

a2-u2-l12.zmiznut.note.en: Past: **zmizol, zmizla**, like spadnúť → spadol, spadla. Torta zmizla! = The cake has disappeared!
a2-u2-l12.zmiznut.note.t: Oʻtgan zamon: **zmizol, zmizla**, spadnúť → spadol, spadla kabi. Torta zmizla! = Tort gʻoyib boʻldi!

a2-u2-l12.fill-torta-zmizla.why.en: Torta is feminine, so the past ends in **-la**: zmiz**la**. Zmizol goes with a masculine word.
a2-u2-l12.fill-torta-zmizla.why.t: Slovak tilida narsalarning ham jinsi bor: torta ayol jinsida, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi: zmiz**la**. Zmizol erkak jinsidagi soʻz bilan keladi.

a2-u2-l12.svedok.note.en: Pán Kováč is playing detective (**detektív**): he's looking for the thief (**zlodej**) and talking to every witness.
a2-u2-l12.svedok.note.t: Janob Kovach detektiv (**detektív**) boʻlib oldi: u oʻgʻrini (**zlodej**) qidiryapti va har bir guvoh bilan gaplashyapti.

en: Mr Kováč is looking for the thief.
Mr Kováč is looking for a witness.
Mr Kováč is looking for the cake.

a2-u2-l12.build-co-ste-robili.prompt.en: What were you doing yesterday at six? (to someone you call vy)
a2-u2-l12.build-co-ste-robili.prompt.t: Kecha soat oltida nima qilayotgan edingiz? (siz)

en: Vy in the past tense takes **ste**: Čo **ste** robili?
With vy, the past form always ends in **-li**, even for one person: **robili** ste.
t: Oʻtgan zamonda vy bilan **ste** keladi: Čo **ste** robili?
vy bilan oʻtgan zamon shakli doim **-li** bilan tugaydi, hatto bitta odamga murojaat qilinsa ham: **robili** ste.

en: I was at the ice rink, skating.
I was at the ice rink and I was skating.
I was at the ice rink and skated.
t: Muz maydonida edim va konkida uchdim.
Muz maydonida edim, konkida uchayotgan edim.
Muz maydonida boʻldim va konkida uchdim.

a2-u2-l12.fill-bola-som-v.en.en: I was in my room, singing. (Lucia)

a2-u2-l12.fill-bola-som-v.why.en: Lucia is talking about herself, a woman, so the past ends in **-la**: spieval**a** som.
a2-u2-l12.fill-bola-som-v.why.t: Lusiya oʻzi haqida gapiryapti, u ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi: spieval**a** som.

a2-u2-l12.fill-tomas-vcera-o.en.en: Yesterday at six Tomáš was playing tennis with a friend.
a2-u2-l12.fill-tomas-vcera-o.en.t: Kecha soat oltida Tomash doʻsti bilan tennis oʻynayotgan edi.

a2-u2-l12.fill-tomas-vcera-o.why.en: Tomáš is a man, so the past ends in **-l**: hral. Hrala is for a woman, hrali for more people.
a2-u2-l12.fill-tomas-vcera-o.why.t: Tomash — erkak, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-l** bilan tugaydi: hral. Hrala — ayol uchun, hrali — bir necha kishi uchun.

en: You're asking about a person, so it's **Kto**. Čo is for things.
After **je**, the noun stays in the basic form: **zlodej**. Zlodeja is the object form.
t: Siz odam haqida soʻrayapsiz, shuning uchun **Kto** (kim). Čo (nima) — narsalar uchun.
**je** dan keyin ot asosiy shaklda qoladi: **zlodej**. Zlodeja — toʻldiruvchi shakli.

a2-u2-l13.grammar-musel-mohol-chcel.titl.en: Musel, mohol, chcel: must, can, want in the past
a2-u2-l13.grammar-musel-mohol-chcel.titl.t: Musel, mohol, chcel: kerak, qila olmoq, xohlamoq oʻtgan zamonda

en: You know **mohol** and **chcel** from A1. **Musieť** goes like vidieť → videl: drop -ieť and add **-el**: musel, musela, museli. **Vedieť** does the same: vedel. **Môcť** is special: mohol, mohla, mohli.
The infinitive after them doesn't change, and som, si, sme, ste come second as always: **Musel som** ísť hore. Prepáč, **nemohla som** prísť.
t: **mohol** va **chcel** ni A1 dan bilasiz. **Musieť** vidieť → videl kabi oʻzgaradi: -ieť ni tashlab, **-el** qoʻshing: musel, musela, museli. **Vedieť** ham shunday: vedel. **Môcť** — oʻziga xos: mohol, mohla, mohli.

Ulardan keyingi infinitív oʻzgarmaydi, som, si, sme, ste esa har doimgidek ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi: **Musel som** ísť hore. = Yuqoriga chiqishim kerak edi. Prepáč, **nemohla som** prísť. = Kechir, kela olmadim.

en: At six I had to go upstairs. (Mr Kováč)
Did you know that? (to a man)
t: Soat oltida yuqoriga chiqishim kerak edi. (janob Kovach)

a2-u2-l13.grammar-came-left-ate.title.en: Came, left, ate, brought: irregular pasts
a2-u2-l13.grammar-came-left-ate.title.t: Keldi, ketdi, yedi, olib keldi: istisnolar

en: A prefix doesn't change the past form. ísť → išiel, so **prísť** (to come) → prišiel and **odísť** (to leave, go away) → odišiel. jesť → jedol, so **zjesť** (to eat up) → zjedol.
**Priniesť** (to bring) and **upiecť** (to bake) add **-ol** for a man and -la for a woman, and upiecť turns c into k: priniesol, priniesla; upiekol, upiekla. And **vziať** → vzal, vzala.
t: Old qoʻshimcha oʻtgan zamon shaklini oʻzgartirmaydi. ísť → išiel, demak **prísť** (kelmoq) → prišiel va **odísť** (ketmoq) → odišiel. jesť → jedol, demak **zjesť** (yeb qoʻymoq) → zjedol.
**Priniesť** (olib kelmoq) va **upiecť** (pishirmoq) erkak uchun **-ol**, ayol uchun -la oladi, upiecť da esa c k ga aylanadi: priniesol, priniesla; upiekol, upiekla. **vziať** esa → vzal, vzala.

en: Marek baked a cake and brought it to the porter's desk.
t: Marek tort pishirdi va uni qorovulxonaga olib keldi.

a2-u2-l13.fill-o-siestej-som.en.en: At six I had to go up to the third floor. (Mr Kováč)
a2-u2-l13.fill-o-siestej-som.en.t: Soat oltida uchinchi qavatga chiqishim kerak edi. (janob Kovach)

a2-u2-l13.fill-o-siestej-som.why.en: Pán Kováč is a man talking about the past: **musel** som. Musím is now, and musela is for a woman.
a2-u2-l13.fill-o-siestej-som.why.t: Janob Kovach — oʻtgan zamon haqida gapirayotgan erkak: **musel** som. Musím — hozir, musela esa ayol uchun.

a2-u2-l13.fill-prepac-vcera-som.why.en: It's the past, and Emma is a woman: **nemohla** som. Nemôžem is now, and nemohol is for a man.
a2-u2-l13.fill-prepac-vcera-som.why.t: Bu oʻtgan zamon, Emma esa ayol: **nemohla** som. Nemôžem — hozir, nemohol esa erkak uchun.

a2-u2-l13.build-marek-priniesol-tortu.pr.en: Marek brought the cake at five.
a2-u2-l13.build-marek-priniesol-tortu.pr.t: Marek tortni soat beshda olib keldi.

en: Marek is a man, so priniesť takes **-ol**: **priniesol**. Priniesla is for a woman.
The cake is the object, so torta changes -a to **-u**: **tortu**.
t: Marek — erkak, shuning uchun priniesť **-ol** oladi: **priniesol**. Priniesla — ayol uchun.
Tort — toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun torta soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: **tortu**.

a2-u2-l13.fill-pan-kovac-odisiel.en.en: Mr Kováč left at six and came back at seven.
a2-u2-l13.fill-pan-kovac-odisiel.en.t: Janob Kovach soat oltida ketdi va soat yettida qaytdi.

a2-u2-l13.fill-pan-kovac-odisiel.why.en: It's the past: ísť → išiel, so odísť → **odišiel**. Odíde is the future, and odišla is for a woman.
a2-u2-l13.fill-pan-kovac-odisiel.why.t: Bu oʻtgan zamon: ísť → išiel, demak odísť → **odišiel**. Odíde — kelasi zamon, odišla esa ayol uchun.

a2-u2-l13.choice-kto-zjedol-tortu.why.en: **Kto** takes the he-form in the past, zje**dol**, before anyone knows who it was. And the cake is the object: **tortu**.
a2-u2-l13.choice-kto-zjedol-tortu.why.t: Oʻtgan zamonda **Kto** bilan erkak shakli keladi: zje**dol**, kim ekani hali nomaʼlum boʻlsa ham. Tort esa toʻldiruvchi: **tortu**.

a2-u2-l13.fill-marek-chcel-prist.en.en: Marek wanted to come, but he had to work.
a2-u2-l13.fill-marek-chcel-prist.en.t: Marek kelmoqchi edi, lekin ishlashi kerak edi.

a2-u2-l13.fill-marek-chcel-prist.why.en: It's the past (musel pracovať), and Marek is a man: **chcel**. Chce is now.
a2-u2-l13.fill-marek-chcel-prist.why.t: Bu oʻtgan zamon (musel pracovať), Marek esa erkak: **chcel**. Chce — hozir.

en: It's the past: chcieť → **chceli**, with sme. Chceme is now.
“We” is my, so the small word is **sme**. Som goes with ja.
t: Bu oʻtgan zamon: chcieť → **chceli**, sme bilan. Chceme — hozir.
«Biz» — my, shuning uchun kichik soʻz **sme**. Som ja bilan keladi.

en: In the present, the ending shows the person: musím, môžeš. In the past, the person moves to **som, si, sme, ste**, and the -l form shows the gender: musel som, musela som.
t: Hozirgi zamonda shaxsni qoʻshimcha koʻrsatadi: musím, môžeš. Oʻtgan zamonda shaxs **som, si, sme, ste** ga oʻtadi, -l shakli esa jinsni koʻrsatadi: musel som (erkak), musela som (ayol).

en: I can't today, and I couldn't yesterday either. (a woman)
t: Bugun kela olmayman, kecha ham kela olmadim. (ayol gapiryapti)

a2-u2-l13.fill-dnes-musim-pracovat.en.en: I have to work today, and I had to work yesterday too. (a woman)
a2-u2-l13.fill-dnes-musim-pracovat.en.t: Bugun ishlashim kerak, kecha ham ishlashim kerak edi. (ayol gapiryapti)

a2-u2-l13.fill-dnes-musim-pracovat.why.en: Včera (yesterday) needs the past, and a woman says **musela** som. Museli goes with my, vy or oni.
a2-u2-l13.fill-dnes-musim-pracovat.why.t: Včera (kecha) oʻtgan zamonni talab qiladi, ayol esa **musela** som deydi. Museli — my, vy yoki oni bilan.

en: Emma is a woman, so the past ends in **-la**: **vedela** si.
“Did you know” is the past: **vedela** si. Vieš is now.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi: **vedela** si.

a2-u2-l13.fill-o-piatej-emma.en.en: At five Emma went to the ice rink.
a2-u2-l13.fill-o-piatej-emma.en.t: Soat beshda Emma muz maydoniga ketdi.

a2-u2-l13.fill-o-piatej-emma.why.en: It's the past, and Emma is a woman: ísť → **išla**. Išiel is for a man.
a2-u2-l13.fill-o-piatej-emma.why.t: Bu oʻtgan zamon, Emma esa ayol: ísť → **išla**. Išiel — erkak uchun.

en: Marek couldn't come, he had to work.
Marek couldn't come because he had to work.
t: Marek kela olmadi, ishlashi kerak edi.
Marek kela olmadi, chunki ishlashi kerak edi.

a2-u2-l14.vlasy.note.en: On Friday Emma saw a young man in the hallway: Mal dlhé **hnedé** vlasy. = He had long brown hair. You know vlasy, krátke, kučeravé and oči from unit 1.
a2-u2-l14.vlasy.note.t: Juma kuni Emma yoʻlakda bir yigitni koʻrdi: Mal dlhé **hnedé** vlasy. = Uning uzun qoʻngʻir sochi bor edi. vlasy, krátke, kučeravé va oči ni 1-boʻlimdan bilasiz.

a2-u2-l14.fill-mal-dlhe-hnede.en.t: Uning uzun qoʻngʻir sochi bor edi.

a2-u2-l14.fill-mal-dlhe-hnede.why.en: Hair is plural in Slovak, **vlasy**, and so are its adjectives: dlh**é** hned**é**.
a2-u2-l14.fill-mal-dlhe-hnede.why.t: Slovak tilida soch koʻplikda: **vlasy**, uning sifatlari ham: dlh**é** hned**é**. Oʻzbekchada esa «soch» birlikda.

a2-u2-l14.brada.note.en: Tomáš má krátku čiernu bradu. = Tomáš has a short black beard. **asi** = about: Mal asi tridsať rokov. = He was about thirty.
a2-u2-l14.brada.note.t: Tomáš má krátku čiernu bradu. = Tomashning kalta qora soqoli bor. **asi** = taxminan: Mal asi tridsať rokov. = U taxminan oʻttiz yoshda edi.

en: He has long black hair and glasses.
He has short brown hair and blue eyes.
He has short black hair and a beard.
t: Uning uzun qora sochi va koʻzoynagi bor.
Uning kalta qoʻngʻir sochi va koʻk koʻzlari bor.
Uning kalta qora sochi va soqoli bor.

en: Age uses **mať** in Slovak: **mal** dvadsať rokov, “he had twenty years”.
From five up, the number takes **rokov**: dvadsať **rokov**.
t: Slovak tilida yosh **mať** (ega boʻlmoq) bilan aytiladi: **mal** dvadsať rokov, soʻzma-soʻz «uning yigirma yili bor edi».
Beshdan boshlab son bilan **rokov** keladi: dvadsať **rokov**.

a2-u2-l14.tichy-a-hanblivy.question.en: Filip, a new student on the second floor, is tichý a hanblivý. What is he like?
a2-u2-l14.tichy-a-hanblivy.question.t: Ikkinchi qavatdagi yangi talaba Filip tichý a hanblivý. U qanday odam?

a2-u2-l14.fill-lucia-je-vesela.en.en: Lucia is cheerful, but Filip is quiet.

a2-u2-l14.fill-lucia-je-vesela.why.en: Filip is a man, so the adjective takes **-ý**: tich**ý**. Tichá is for a woman.
a2-u2-l14.fill-lucia-je-vesela.why.t: Filip — erkak, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** oladi: tich**ý**. Tichá — ayol uchun.

a2-u2-l14.pes.note.en: As an object it's **psa**: Mám psa. = I've got a dog. Plural: **psy**. A little dog is a **psík**.
a2-u2-l14.pes.note.t: Toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda **psa**: Mám psa. = Mening itim bor. Koʻplik: **psy**. Kichkina it — **psík**.

a2-u2-l14.build-emma-videla-maleho.promp.en: Emma saw a small white dog.

en: A dog is a living being, so as an object its adjective takes **-ého**, like nového kamaráta: **malého** bieleho psa.
The dog is the object: pes loses its e and adds -a, **psa**.
t: It — jonli mavjudot, shuning uchun toʻldiruvchi boʻlganda uning sifati **-ého** oladi, nového kamaráta kabi: **malého** bieleho psa.
It — toʻldiruvchi: pes e harfini yoʻqotib, -a oladi: **psa**.

a2-u2-l14.chovat-psa.note.en: **chovať** + the object form = to keep (an animal): Chováte doma zviera? = Do you have a pet? But: Na internáte nesmieme chovať zvieratá. = We mustn't keep animals in the dorm.
a2-u2-l14.chovat-psa.note.t: **chovať** + akuzatív = (hayvon) boqmoq: Chováte doma zviera? = Uyda hayvon boqasizmi? Lekin: Na internáte nesmieme chovať zvieratá. = Yotoqxonada hayvon boqishimiz mumkin emas.

a2-u2-l14.fill-filip-chova-psa.en.en: Filip keeps a dog, but he isn't allowed to in the dorm.
a2-u2-l14.fill-filip-chova-psa.en.t: Filip it boqadi, lekin yotoqxonada bunga ruxsat yoʻq.

a2-u2-l14.fill-filip-chova-psa.why.en: Filip is **on**, so the verb has no ending: **chová**, like číta. Chovám is ja, chovajú is oni.
a2-u2-l14.fill-filip-chova-psa.why.t: Filip — **on** (u), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **chová**, číta kabi. Chovám — ja, chovajú — oni.

a2-u2-l14.choice-prepacte-pan-kovac.ques.en: Filip says this. Who ate the cake?
a2-u2-l14.choice-prepacte-pan-kovac.ques.t: Filip shunday deydi. Tortni kim yeb qoʻydi?

a2-u2-l14.build-ma-modre-oci.prompt.en: She has blue eyes and long hair.
a2-u2-l14.build-ma-modre-oci.prompt.t: Uning koʻk koʻzlari va uzun sochi bor.

en: Oči is plural, so the adjective ends in **-é**: **modré** oči.
Vlasy is plural too, so it's **dlhé** vlasy.
t: Oči — koʻplik, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: **modré** oči.
Vlasy ham koʻplik, shuning uchun **dlhé** vlasy.

a2-u2-l14.si-nahnevany.note.en: **nahnevaný** = angry, **prekvapený** = surprised. The dog is small and very **priateľský** (friendly), so pán Kováč can't stay angry. To vy: Ste nahnevaný?
a2-u2-l14.si-nahnevany.note.t: **nahnevaný** = jahli chiqqan, **prekvapený** = hayron. It kichkina va juda **priateľský** (doʻstona), shuning uchun janob Kovach uzoq jahl qilib turolmaydi. «Siz»ga: Ste nahnevaný?

a2-u2-l14.fill-pan-kovac-nie.en.en: Mr Kováč isn't angry, just surprised.
a2-u2-l14.fill-pan-kovac-nie.en.t: Janob Kovachning jahli chiqmagan, u shunchaki hayron.

a2-u2-l14.fill-pan-kovac-nie.why.en: Pán Kováč is one man, so the adjective takes **-ý**: prekvapen**ý**, like nahnevaný. Prekvapená is for a woman, prekvapení for a group.
a2-u2-l14.fill-pan-kovac-nie.why.t: Janob Kovach — bitta erkak, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** oladi: prekvapen**ý**, nahnevaný kabi. Prekvapená — ayol uchun, prekvapení — guruh uchun.

en: Filip's dog is small and very friendly.
t: Filipning iti kichkina va juda doʻstona.
Filipning iti kichkina va juda mehribon.
Filipning iti kichik va juda doʻstona.

a2-u2-pisanie.listen-mas-chut-ist.en.en: Do you fancy going to the swimming pool?

a2-u2-pisanie.listen-emma-a-lucia.en.t: Emma va Lusiya raqsga tushishni yoqtirishadi.

a2-u2-pisanie.listen-bohuzial-nemozem-mu.en: Unfortunately I can't, I have to work.

a2-u2-pisanie.listen-o-siestej-som.en.en: At six I had to leave.

a2-u2-l15.fill-emma-a-lucia.en.t: Emma va Lusiya konkida uchishni yoqtirishadi.

a2-u2-l15.fill-emma-a-lucia.why.en: Two women are **ony**, so it's **rady**. Radi needs a man in the group.
a2-u2-l15.fill-emma-a-lucia.why.t: Ikki ayol — **ony**, shuning uchun **rady**. Radi uchun guruhda erkak boʻlishi kerak.

a2-u2-l15.build-dakujem-za-pozvanie.prom.en: Thanks for the invitation, but I can't.
a2-u2-l15.build-dakujem-za-pozvanie.prom.t: Taklif uchun rahmat, lekin kela olmayman.

en: You're talking about yourself, ja, so it's **nemôžem**. Nemôžeš is ty.
You thank someone **za** something: ďakujem **za** pozvanie.
t: Siz oʻzingiz haqingizda gapiryapsiz (ja), shuning uchun **nemôžem**. Nemôžeš — ty.
Biror narsa uchun rahmat aytganda **za** ishlatiladi: ďakujem **za** pozvanie.

a2-u2-l15.choice-mojim-konickom-je.why.en: Mojím and koníčkom go together, both in the with form: **mojím koníčkom**. Or both in the basic form: môj koníček.
a2-u2-l15.choice-mojim-konickom-je.why.t: Mojím va koníčkom birga keladi, ikkalasi ham inštrumentálda: **mojím koníčkom**. Yoki ikkalasi ham asosiy shaklda: môj koníček.

a2-u2-l15.fill-pozrieme-si-ten.en.en: Shall we watch that new film?

a2-u2-l15.fill-pozrieme-si-ten.why.en: Watching something for yourself is **pozrieť si**. Pozrieť sa needs na: pozrieť sa na plagát.
a2-u2-l15.fill-pozrieme-si-ten.why.t: Oʻzingiz uchun biror narsani tomosha qilish — **pozrieť si**. Pozrieť sa bilan na kerak: pozrieť sa na plagát.

en: Tomáš is the subject and it's his own chess set, so it's **svoj**. Jeho šach would be another man's.
Tomáš is a man: **priniesol**. Priniesla is for a woman.
t: Tomash — gapning egasi, shaxmat ham oʻziniki, shuning uchun **svoj**. Jeho šach — boshqa erkakning shaxmati boʻlardi.

a2-u2-l15.fill-vezmes-si-plavky.why.en: Taking something for yourself takes **si**, with the thing after it: vezmeš **si** plavky, like dať si kávu.
a2-u2-l15.fill-vezmes-si-plavky.why.t: Oʻzingiz uchun biror narsa olish **si** bilan aytiladi, narsa undan keyin keladi: vezmeš **si** plavky, dať si kávu kabi.

en: Mr Kováč wanted to go upstairs.
Mr Kováč had to go upstairs.
t: Janob Kovach yuqoriga chiqishi kerak edi.

a2-u2-l15.choice-pan-kovac-musel.why.en: **Musel** is the past of musieť (must, have to): he had to go. Wanted would be chcel, could mohol.
a2-u2-l15.choice-pan-kovac-musel.why.t: **Musel** — musieť (kerak, majbur boʻlmoq) feʼlining oʻtgan zamoni: chiqishi kerak edi. «Chiqmoqchi edi» — chcel, «chiqa olardi» — mohol boʻlardi.

a2-u2-l15.fill-hras-na-klaviri.why.en: Instruments take **na** + the where form: hrať **na** klavíri, na gitare.
a2-u2-l15.fill-hras-na-klaviri.why.t: Cholgʻu asboblari bilan **na** + lokál keladi: hrať **na** klavíri, na gitare.

en: I used to play the violin.
At one time I played the violin.

a2-u2-l15.fill-tomas-nema-rad.why.en: Tomáš is **on**, so mať is **má**, and ne- goes on the verb: **nemá** rád. Tancovanie is the noun from tancovať.
a2-u2-l15.fill-tomas-nema-rad.why.t: Tomash — **on** (u), shuning uchun mať — **má**, ne- esa feʼlga qoʻshiladi: **nemá** rád. Tancovanie — tancovať (raqsga tushmoq) dan yasalgan ot.

en: Lucia is a woman, so the past ends in **-la**: **nemohla**. Nemohol is for a man.
“Couldn't” is the past: **nemohla**. Nemôže is now.
t: Lusiya — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon **-la** bilan tugaydi: **nemohla**. Nemohol — erkak uchun.

a2-u2-l15.choice-tichy.question.en: Filip hardly says a word. Which word describes him?
a2-u2-l15.choice-tichy.question.t: Filip deyarli gapirmaydi. Qaysi soʻz uni tasvirlaydi?

en: Lucia is allergic to cats, but she likes dogs.
Lucia is allergic to cats but likes dogs.
t: Lusiyaning mushuklarga allergiyasi bor, lekin itlarni yoqtiradi.
Lusiyaning mushuklarga allergiyasi bor, ammo itlarni yoqtiradi.
Lusiyaning mushuklarga allergiyasi bor, lekin u itlarni yoqtiradi.
